tasks.title: SaleTriageOrchestrator (cost-aware routing)
tasks.description: One structured AI call over NEW unreviewed items: cluster by brand+category; route each item/cluster to skip|group_surface|item_surface|deep_candidate using price threshold + category complexity + per-cycle deep budget. Write sale_research_clusters. Log skips.
tasks.success: Cheap commodity items clustered to one pass; high-value+complex flagged deep_candidate; routing logged.

tasks.title: Queue + Workflow + Agent DO scaffold
tasks.description: SHOPPING_QUEUE (producer enqueues orchestrator-selected tasks, per cluster or standout item); ShoppingScoreWorkflow (surface->conditional deep->write); PersonalizedShoppingAgent DO (bump DO migration tag, export in _worker.ts). Generic ShoppingTask contract.
tasks.success: Task flows Queue->Workflow->DO; DO reusable via generic task; deploys without 10074.

tasks.title: Surface pass agent + tools
tasks.description: PersonalizedShoppingAgent tools: web_search, browser_render, get_sale_item. Structured output = deal_score + insight + recommendation{needs_deep,reason,search_plan,confidence}. Group passes fan one summary to each item. Every item gets an insight.
tasks.success: Surface pass returns score+insight+recommendation for a real item; group summary applied to cluster.

tasks.title: Deep escalation (gated) + write
tasks.description: Escalate to existing deep-research engine ONLY when needs_deep && price >= deep_research_min_price_cents && cycle deep-runs < budget. Else keep surface insight + research_reason='deep suggested but gated' + manual affordance. Write deal_score/savings/insight/research_tier/confidence/reason/cluster_id/deep_research_ref. Close cycle status=scored.
tasks.success: Sub-Zero-class item escalates; $99 sink does not; deep runs <= per-cycle budget; gated escalations logged + manually triggerable.
